changelog:
Cameras added by RTSP URL alone, such as a Wyze Cam v4, now show their resolution, frame rate, bitrate and MAC address in the device drawer.
On phones, the notifications panel stays on screen and no longer runs behind the bottom tab bar.
When a recorder refuses a sign-in from the Site Manager, the live wall and the sign-in page now say why.
Push notifications go to each user's 10 most recently registered phones.
Resetting your Site Manager password now emails you that it was changed.
